title: MS PKI Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) Architect
description:
MS PKI Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) Architect

**Company:**
A leading global IT services and consulting MNC

**Locations:**
Pune / Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata

**Overall Experience:**
7–14 Years

**Core PKI Experience:**
Minimum 8–9 years of hands-on PKI experience, as specified in the requirement

**Open Positions:**
1

**Notice Period:**
Immediate to 15 Days preferred

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced MS PKI / Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) Architect to lead the design, implementation, and management of enterprise Public Key Infrastructure and certificate lifecycle solutions.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Microsoft PKI, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate lifecycle management platforms, and enterprise certificate automation.

Mandatory Skills

* Strong hands-on experience in PKI and certificate lifecycle management.
* Mandatory experience implementing Microsoft PKI / Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Experience with at least one CLM or certificate management platform:
* AppViewX CERT+
* CyberArk Certificate Manager
* Venafi Trust Protection Platform
* DigiCert
* Keyfactor
* Experience managing certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong understanding of PKI architecture, certificate governance, cryptographic standards, trust models, and private key protection.
* Experience integrating CLM platforms with enterprise systems and public Certificate Authorities.
* Experience in certificate automation, scripting, and workflow development.

Preferred Skills

* Microsoft PKI / AD CS administration and implementation.
* Knowledge of DigiCert, Sectigo, Entrust, and GlobalSign.
* Familiarity with ACME, EST, and SCEP protocols.
* Cloud certificate management using Azure Key Vault, AWS Certificate Manager, or Google CAS.
* PowerShell, REST APIs, and automation.
* ServiceNow integration.
* PKI architecture, certificate governance, and security compliance.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead enterprise certificate lifecycle operations, including discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Design, implement, and manage CLM solutions using AppViewX, CyberArk Certificate Manager, Venafi, Keyfactor, and Microsoft PKI.
* Integrate certificate management platforms with AD CS, public CAs, cloud platforms, ITSM solutions, load balancers, web servers, and DevOps ecosystems.
* Develop automated certificate management workflows using platform-native tools, PowerShell, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Maintain certificate inventories, monitor expiration risks, and establish certificate governance and compliance controls.
* Define security policies for certificate issuance, cryptographic standards, key management, and private key protection.
* Establish dashboards, reporting, monitoring, and audit processes for certificate health and operational performance.
* Support certificate onboarding and automation across servers, applications, cloud services, and container platforms.
* Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and Application teams.
* Mentor team members on PKI, CLM platforms, automation, and best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in certificate visibility, automation, and operational efficiency.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on PKI professional with proven AD CS implementation experience, strong enterprise certificate lifecycle management expertise, and the ability to design and automate secure certificate management solutions.

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
description:
About pharma&

pharma& is a privately owned global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We focus on breathing new life into proven medicines, preserving their availability, and ensuring essential treatments reach patients worldwide. With a growing portfolio across haematology, oncology and other therapeutic areas, we operate through a global network of subsidiaries, joint ventures and partners to support development, manufacturing and access.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Microsoft 365 Administrator to join our Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad.

You will be responsible for the administration, security, reliability and continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 environment, supporting colleagues across our global organisation.

This is a
**100% hands-on technical position**
, not a coordination or management role. You will be expected to work directly within Microsoft administration portals, troubleshoot complex issues, implement configuration changes and take ownership of assigned services.

Working closely with our international IT team, you will also help strengthen security, improve operational processes, maintain documentation and reduce reliance on external support providers.

Key Responsibilities

**Microsoft 365 & Exchange Online**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services, tenant configurations, user accounts, groups, licensing and service health.
* Manage Exchange Online, including shared mailboxes, distribution lists, delegation, mail flow, email authentication and archiving.
* Monitor mailbox capacity, retention and recoverability, and resolve escalated email-related issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 licensing management, optimisation and administrative reporting.

**SharePoint, OneDrive & Microsoft Teams**

* Administer SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams, including provisioning, permissions, external sharing and governance.
* Review and remediate excessive access permissions, oversharing risks and inappropriate external access.
* Support SharePoint governance and access reviews using administrative tools such as SysKit or equivalent solutions.
* Work with business stakeholders to ensure confidential information is appropriately protected.

**Microsoft Entra ID & Endpoint Management**

* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including identity lifecycle management, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access and enterprise application integrations.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application deployment and endpoint configuration.
* Support Windows and mobile-device management, including device provisioning, security and offboarding.
* Maintain secure administrative access, including emergency access accounts and privileged access controls.

**Security, Compliance & Data Protection**

* Configure and maintain Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, retention, audit and eDiscovery.
* Support legal hold, data preservation and authorised discovery requests in coordination with Legal, Compliance and IT leadership.
* Administer Microsoft 365 backup and recovery solutions, including AvePoint or equivalent platforms.
* Perform data restoration, recovery testing and maintain supporting documentation.
* Work with the Security Analyst to implement security recommendations and remediate Microsoft 365 configuration weaknesses.

**Microsoft 365 Copilot & Automation**

* Support Microsoft 365 Copilot administration, licensing, configuration and ongoing governance.
* Assess SharePoint and OneDrive permissions and data exposure risks associated with Copilot.
* Work with stakeholders to implement appropriate access controls before and during AI adoption.
* Automate repetitive administration using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other approved Microsoft tools.

**IT Operations & Continuous Improvement**

* Resolve escalated Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests through the IT service management platform.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures and troubleshooting runbooks.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, access reviews, audits and periodic administrative activities.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security and support colleagues on cross-platform incidents and changes.
* Support Microsoft 365 tenant migrations, integration projects and platform improvements where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, automation and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum
  **5 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience**
  in a corporate or enterprise environment.
* Strong practical expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams administration.
* Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and identity security.
* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, device compliance, configuration and application deployment.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview, including retention, data loss prevention and eDiscovery.
* Experience troubleshooting complex Microsoft 365 issues and implementing configuration changes independently.
* Good PowerShell scripting skills and familiarity with Microsoft Graph.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security principles, least-privilege access and data protection.
* Strong communication, problem-solving and documentation skills.

Desirable Experience

* AvePoint or another enterprise Microsoft 365 backup and recovery solution.
* SysKit or similar SharePoint governance and reporting tools.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot administration and information protection.
* Microsoft 365 tenant migrations or multi-tenant environments.
* Experience supporting regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals or life sciences.
* Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, MD-102, SC-300 or SC-400.

Why Join pharma&?

* Work directly with a global IT team supporting an international pharmaceutical organisation.
* Take genuine technical ownership of enterprise Microsoft 365 services.
* Gain exposure to security, compliance, modern workplace technologies and AI governance.
* Join a growing GCC with opportunities to develop your technical expertise and responsibilities.

Working Conditions

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, India – office-based position.
* **Working hours:**
  11:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST, aligned with European business hours.
* **Employment:**
  Full-time.
* **Work environment:**
  International corporate setting, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries.

Workplace Expectations

* Maintain strict confidentiality and protect sensitive company and business information.
* Follow company security policies, change management procedures and professional conduct standards.
* Take ownership of technical responsibilities and maintain clear, accurate operational documentation.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (Office-based)

**Working hours:**
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

**Experience:**
5+ years

**Employment type:**
Full-time

title: Platform Operations Engineer (Work Timings :- 03:00 AM IST to 11:30 AM IST )
description:
**Job Purpose**
As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
* Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
* Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
* Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
* Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
* Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
* Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
* Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
* Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
* Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Pay Transparency Notice
  
  
**Role**
Tungsten Automation is committed to fair, consistent, and transparent pay practices, wherever we operate. Before any interview or salary discussion, we disclose the following for this role:
  
  

* Base pay range: For this role, based in India, the base pay range is 3000000-400000 INR, set using objective, gender-neutral and otherwise non-discriminatory job evaluation criteria applied consistently to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.
* Total compensation: This range reflects base pay only. Tungsten Automation may also offer bonuses, commissions, equity, and benefits, described separately where applicable or required by local law.
* How your pay is determined: Your base pay within this range will be based on objective, non-discriminatory factors — such as location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and education or training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary, and will not fall below the disclosed range or below what colleagues performing equal work or work of equal value receive.
* Salary history: Tungsten Automation does not ask candidates about current or past pay, and you are not required to disclose it, except where local law expressly permits or requires this.
* Your right to discuss pay: Nothing in this notice limits your right to discuss your own pay, to negotiate, or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Tungsten Automation does not retaliate against employees or candidates for discussing compensation.
* Questions: If you have questions about this notice or how pay was determined for this role, contact talent@tungstenautomation.com.

*While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.*
**Required Skills**
**Required Qualifications**

* Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
* Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
* Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
* Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
* Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
* Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
* Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
* Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
* Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
* Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows
* Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
* Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.
* Understanding of platform SLOs, Error budgets, operational maturity models, and infrastructure lifecycle thinking.

**As a successful Cloud Platform Engineer**
You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. You’re driven by delivery, not novelty, and thrive on solving operational complexity through design, automation, and simplification. You treat infrastructure the same way great product teams treat software as something to be designed, tested, versioned, and continuously improved.
  
  
***Tungsten Automation Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/Disability/Vets***

title: Senior IT Technologist - IT Digital Monitoring and Observation Lead
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Support the strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise monitoring and observability solutions for digital manufacturing systems. Implement logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting capabilities that enhance system reliability, operational visibility, and uptime across manufacturing sites and distribution centers. Partner with DevOps, engineering, and operations teams to embed observability into deployment pipelines and establish consistent monitoring standards. Use telemetry and performance analytics to proactively detect issues, optimize system performance, support capacity planning, and drive continuous improvement across OT/IT environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Lead and support the implementation, and sustainment of Digital Transformation Monitoring—including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting—to improve reliability, uptime, and operational visibility.
* Provide proactive detection of performance degradation, failures, and anomalies across applications, data pipelines, and OT/IT interfaces.
* Collaborate with DevOps, engineering, and operations teams to embed observability requirements into deployment pipelines.
* Develop and maintain monitoring governance standards to ensure consistency across mfg. sites and DC’s (Distribution Centers).
* Performs quality control audits to ensure accuracy, completeness, and proper usage of data in tables and various support tools, such as database dictionaries.
* Reviews database design and integration of systems, including client/servers, mainframes, etc., and makes recommendations regarding enhancements and/or improvements.
* Enforce policies, procedures, and standards relating to database management, and monitors transaction activity and utilization.
* Prepares and/or reviews activity, progress, and performance reports.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree, overall 7+years IT experience and minimum 3-5 years of experience in supporting enterprise monitoring, observability, platform operations, or related technology functions.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise monitoring and observability solutions, including logging, metrics, alerting, dashboarding, and distributed tracing.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms, enterprise applications, infrastructure, data platforms, or integrated Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) environments.
* Experience analyzing system performance data, troubleshooting production issues, and using telemetry and analytics to drive operational improvements and system reliability.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and operations teams to implement monitoring standards, observability practices, and operational governance across enterprise environments.

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Dynatrace, SolarWinds, CloudWatch, or comparable tools, including logging, distributed tracing, anomaly detection, event correlation, and AIOps.
* Knowledge of cloud-native architectures and DevOps practices, including AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, containers, serverless technologies, CI/CD, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and automated deployments.
* Experience monitoring databases, APIs, integrations, messaging and streaming platforms, and distributed applications, including technologies such as PostgreSQL, Kafka, and MQTT.
* Understanding of manufacturing IT/OT environments, service reliability practices, security and regulatory expectations, and continuous improvement within global, cross-functional organizations.

title: Executive | Supplier Cyber Assurance - Cyber Analyst
description:
Join our Supplier Cyber Assurance team and help protect Macquarie by monitoring and responding to cyber incidents across our third-party supplier network. Our dynamic and collaborative team works at frontline of supplier cyber risk, ensuring threats are identified early and managed effectively.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

In this role, you will monitor cyber incidents impacting third-party suppliers and assess potential risks to Macquarie. You’ll triage incident notifications, evaluate business impact, and coordinate responses with relevant stakeholders. Working closely with business teams and technical SMEs, you'll drive remediation efforts, strengthen supplier cyber resilience, and support Macquarie's risk culture and risk appetite.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 4-8 years’ experience in cybersecurity, with exposure to incident response, cyber monitoring, or third-party risk management.
* Strong understanding of incident triage, common cyber threats, and threat intelligence, with the ability to assess and prioritize risks effectively.
* Familiarity with third-party cyber risk monitoring and external risk rating tools, or a strong willingness to develop expertise in these areas.
* Experience evaluating supplier security posture and interpreting risk signals to determine appropriate actions and escalations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, GIAC, SC-200) and a keen interest in supply chain security and cyber assurance viewed favourably.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

title: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Analyst
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Analyst, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Analyst specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Analyst on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.

The Senior Security Engineer – Insider Threat & Data Protection (DLP) is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing data protection and insider threat detection technologies to safeguard Mattel’s global enterprise. This senior-level role focuses on preventing data loss, detecting insider-driven risks, and ensuring compliance with privacy and data protection standards. The position combines strong technical expertise with investigative and analytical skills to identify, respond to, and mitigate potential insider threats while fostering a culture of security and trust across the organization.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Engineer, implement, and manage enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and insider threat monitoring solutions across Mattel’s global environments.

* Integrate DLP and insider threat technologies with identity, cloud, and endpoint platforms to improve visibility, correlation, and automated response.
* Collaborate with Legal, HR, and Compliance teams to ensure insider threat monitoring aligns with ethical, privacy, and global data protection standards.

* Create and maintain dashboards and metrics that measure DLP effectiveness, insider threat trends, and overall program performance.
* Collaborate with IT, Infrastructure, and Security Engineering teams to enable secure collaboration and ensure compliance with data handling policies.
* Develop and maintain documentation, operational standards, and playbooks for data loss prevention, insider threat response, and investigation workflows.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging DLP and behavioral analytics tools to enhance detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.
* Support audits and compliance assessments related to data protection and insider threat management frameworks.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by automating repetitive analysis and monitoring tasks where possible.

* 5–7+ years of experience in security engineering, data protection, or insider threat operations within enterprise environments.

* Experience analyzing user activity and data movement to detect anomalous or risky behavior.
* Proficiency in integrating DLP and insider threat technologies with SIEM, SOAR, and cloud platforms for enhanced visibility and automation.

* Experience in policy tuning, rule creation, and reducing false positives within DLP and insider threat systems.

* Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework for insider threat and data exfiltration scenarios.

10 00 – 18 00 PST (22 30 – 06 30 IST), Monday through Friday, with emergency on-call responsibilities as required.

title: Cyber- DT&P-Strategy & Architecture - AI Security Analyst
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Analyst, Strategy and Architecture
  
  
As an AI Cyber Strategy & Architecture Consultant in Deloitte Cyber for AI practice, you will help clients build the foundational AI security strategies, reference secure AI architectures, and governance frameworks needed to adopt AI securely and at scale. Working alongside experienced architects and senior practitioners, you will contribute to the design and delivery of AI security blueprints, threat models, and compliance alignment programs that span cloud, data, identity, and agentic systems. The role blends rigorous technical analysis with structured client engagement and hands-on delivery.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Cyber Strategy and Architecture Analyst, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Translate regulatory and framework requirements, including NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act and ISO 42001 Controls into practical, implementable security controls across AI platforms and data pipelines.
* Assess clients’ AI cybersecurity posture against their business environment, objectives, and risk appetite; identify key strengths and gaps, and develop prioritized recommendations aligned to their constraints and priorities.
* Evaluate AI-specific risks through structured risk assessments and threat modeling, including prompt injection, data leakage, model supply chain compromise, and agentic privilege escalation scenarios.
* Translate assessment findings into enterprise AI security roadmaps by mapping current-state capabilities to target-state architectures, defining required controls, and documenting sequenced remediation actions.
* Contribute to the development, review, and updating of cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures to incorporate AI-specific risks and controls.
* Contribute to the development of AI security reference architectures covering LLM deployment patterns, RAG pipelines, vector databases, agentic workflows, and model-serving architecture.
* Develop impactful reports and presentations that support the achievement of engagement goals and objectives.
* Collaborate with client engineering, security operations, and business stakeholders to validate architecture decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise security standards.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Takes ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables, managing time and quality with minimal oversight while keeping senior colleagues informed of progress and blockers.
* Communicates complex technical architecture and risk concepts clearly in written and verbal formats, adapting the level of detail for engineering teams and business stakeholders alike.
* Approaches unfamiliar AI platforms, frameworks, and threat vectors with structured curiosity - decomposing problems, researching quickly, and applying findings to real client contexts.
* Demonstrates a delivery-first mindset, consistently producing high-quality work products on schedule and proactively flagging risks to project timelines.
* Collaborates effectively across multidisciplinary teams spanning AI engineering, cloud security, identity, data, and risk management.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads and people are identified, authenticated, authorized and governed across enterprise and cloud environments.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated exposure to technology strategy engagements, risk assessments and security architecture.
* Familiarity with established cybersecurity and AI governance frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 or the EU AI Act.
* Experience conducting or contributing to threat modeling, architecture risk assessments, or security gap analyses against defined control frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including an understanding of native security services, shared responsibility models, and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including how LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic systems function, and the security risks they introduce.
* Ability to produce clear, structured technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, control mapping matrices, risk registers, and strategy decks - suitable for both engineering and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services, self-hosted and other AI platforms.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Hands-on experience developing AI cyber security assessments, AI threat modelling and AI policies and standards development.

title: Senior Engineer – Integrated Command Center (ICC)
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Role Overview**
LPL Financial is seeking a
**Senior**
**Engineer – Integrated Command Center (ICC)**
to serve as a
**principal technical authority**
within Production Services. This role is responsible for
**enterprise‑wide incident response excellence, observability maturity, and operational resilience**
across LPL’s most critical platforms.
  
  
As a Senior Engineer, you will lead
**complex incident management, advanced diagnostics, monitoring strategy, and systemic risk reduction**
initiatives. You will partner deeply with SRE, Observability, Infrastructure, Automation, and Application Engineering teams to proactively prevent incidents, reduce detection ambiguity, and improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to restore (MTTR) at scale.
  
  
This is a high‑impact role focused on
**technical leadership, influence, and long‑term reliability outcomes**
, rather than day‑to‑day alert handling.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Incident Response Leadership**

* Act as a principal technical authority during high‑severity and enterprise‑impacting incidents.
* Lead advanced troubleshooting and multi‑domain triage across applications, infrastructure, cloud, and network layers.
* Drive technical containment and restoration strategy in partnership with domain engineering teams.
* Establish incident command best practices, escalation models, and responder behaviors.
* Ensure incidents are resolved with a focus on durable fixes, not temporary recovery.

**Observability & Monitoring Strategy**

* Own and evolve the ICC monitoring and observability strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise reliability objectives.
* Define standards for actionable alerting, thresholds, routing, deduplication, and noise reduction.
* Architect and oversee Dynatrace dashboards, service views, and eyes‑on‑glass experiences for mission‑critical services.
* Partner with Observability and SRE teams to improve logs, metrics, traces, and service telemetry coverage.
* Continuously evaluate tooling capabilities to ensure operational visibility keeps pace with platform complexity.

**Advanced Platform Diagnostics**

* Perform deep, cross‑stack troubleshooting across AWS, Windows, Linux, networking, middleware, databases, and application services.
* Validate hypotheses using evidence‑based diagnostics rather than trial‑and‑error recovery.
* Serve as a go‑to expert for complex, ambiguous failure scenarios and cascading incidents.
* Provide technical guidance to reduce time‑to‑diagnose during critical events.

**Root Cause & Resilience Engineering**

* Lead or significantly influence complex root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents.
* Identify systemic weaknesses, architectural risks, and operational gaps.
* Translate incident learnings into preventative engineering, monitoring, or process improvements.
* Track recurring failure modes and sponsor long‑term remediation initiatives.

**Operational Readiness & Risk Management**

* Drive operational readiness reviews for new or materially changed services.
* Ensure services meet readiness standards including:

+ Monitoring and alerting coverage
+ Runbooks and escalation paths
+ Rollback and recovery procedures
+ Defined SLOs / SLIs (where applicable)

* Partner with engineering teams early in the delivery lifecycle to reduce production risk.

**Technical Influence & Mentorship**

* Mentor senior and mid‑level ICC, NOC, and production support engineers.
* Raise the technical bar for troubleshooting rigor, documentation quality, and incident response discipline.
* Influence reliability outcomes across teams without direct authority.
* Share expertise through post‑incident reviews, technical sessions, and operational drills.

**Goals & Outcomes**

* Deliver measurable, sustained improvements in MTTD and MTTR for priority platforms.
* Reduce repeat incidents and operational toil through systemic fixes.
* Improve signal‑to‑noise ratio across enterprise monitoring.
* Enable responders to diagnose complex failures rapidly and confidently.
* Increase overall production resilience and advisor/client experience.

**Required Expertise & Experience**

* 10-14+ years of progressive experience in Production Services, SRE, ICC/NOC, or large‑scale operations engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in enterprise incident management and ITSM practices.
* Advanced, hands‑on experience with Dynatrace (dashboards, alerts, service flows, diagnostics).
* Strong troubleshooting capabilities across:

+ AWS (EC2, ALB/NLB, RDS, IAM, networking, failure modes)
+ Windows & Linux (performance, services, logs, resource analysis)

* Proven experience operating in high‑severity, high‑stakes incident environments.
* Strong documentation and communication skills at technical and executive levels.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems thinking across complex, distributed architectures.
* Ability to resolve ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward prevention and automation.
* Exceptional collaboration and influence across engineering, leadership, and operations teams.
* Relentless focus on reliability, clarity, and operational maturity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial Services or highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience working closely with SRE or Reliability Engineering teams.
* Familiarity with automation in incident response or operational workflows.
* Experience defining monitoring or operational standards at scale.

**Why This Role Matters**
**Role**
This Senior Engineer role is
**foundational to LPL’s production reliability posture**
. The decisions, standards, and influence of this position directly shape:
  
  

* Platform stability
* Incident outcomes

Advisor and investor experience
  
  

* Organizational confidence in production operations

title: Engineering Analyst, YouTube Trust and Safety
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
* 2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
* 2 years of experience or familiarity with machine learning systems.
* Experience creating opportunities to innovate, conceptualize and complete while working with global teams. Experience collecting, managing and synthesizing large datasets and information from disparate sources, statistical modeling, data mining and data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
As an Engineering Analyst on the YouTube Trust and Safety team, you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute, globally. You will be passionate about technologies and have experience with analyzing large scale data and scaled systems of review. You will thrive in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor to the strategy for reducing network badness on YouTube. You will be an independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for coaching others, solving technological tests and setting scalable standards. You will balance the short-term requirements we face while demonstrating the ability to see the big picture and make quantitatively based long-term recommendations accordingly. You may require on-call work at weekends on a rotational basis. You will also be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform fraud and spam investigations using various data sources, identify product vulnerabilities and drive anti-abuse experiments to prevent abuse. Work with engineers and interact cross-functionally with stakeholders to improve workflows via process improvements, automation and anti-abuse system creation.
* Design and refine prompts for LLMs to improve their accuracy in identifying and classifying abusive content and behavior.
* Apply advanced statistical methods to large complex datasets to understand the impact of abuse to the YouTube ecosystem. Contribute strategy and development of new workflows against additional known vectors of abuse.
* Learn complex and technical concepts and systems and deliver meaningful results using them. Communicate highly technical results and methods.
* Maintain, foster and promote quality by providing regular feedback metrics to the Global team. Manage technological solutions for streamlining quality assurance and produce scalable training solutions to emergent workflows.

title: Manager I, Ops, Linehaul
description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
  
  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
  
  
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
* Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
* Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
* Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
* Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.
* Business Reviews & Escalation Management — Own and drive operational review cadences including business review content preparation and escalation management. Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.
* Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
* Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.
* Project Delivery & Execution — Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of projects and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
* Program Alignment & Business Understanding — Ensure program alignment with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives. Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.
* Stakeholder Management & Risk Culture — Maintain structured stakeholder cadences with country-specific leadership, operations execution, procurement, and carrier management teams across all assigned RoW geographies. Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level, SQL, and MS Access
* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement documents

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- Amazon Dev Center India - Hyderabad - A85

title: Senior
description:
Senior Manager – Certificates & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

Kolkata & Hyderabad

About the Role

Inceptial Tech is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) engineering and certificate lifecycle management within the Information Security function.

The role involves managing enterprise PKI platforms, cryptographic key protection, certificate automation, and security operations while leading engineering teams and ensuring reliable, secure production services.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead PKI engineering teams and oversee technical delivery.

\* Manage enterprise Certificate Authority (CA) hierarchies, HSMs, and key management processes.

\* Oversee certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and lifecycle automation.

\* Manage code-signing, device certificates, and user certificate services.

\* Define cryptographic standards, certificate policies, and approved algorithms.

\* Coordinate with vendors and Certificate Authority providers.

\* Ensure platform availability, audit readiness, and certificate expiry prevention.

\* Support cryptographic agility and post-quantum cryptography migration planning.

Required Skills

\* Strong expertise in PKI architecture and certificate lifecycle management.

\* Knowledge of X.509 certificates, TLS, certificate validation, revocation, and trust stores.

\* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).

\* Familiarity with platforms such as Venafi, Keyfactor, DigiCert, Entrust, or HashiCorp Vault.

\* Experience with ACME, certificate automation, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).

\* Strong knowledge of cryptographic key management and code signing.

\* Experience in technical leadership, vendor management, and security operations.

Experience & Qualifications

\* 15–18 years of experience in infrastructure or security engineering.

\* At least 3 years of team management or technical leadership experience.

\* Experience managing enterprise-scale PKI platforms and production certificate services.

\* CISSP, CISM, or relevant PKI certifications are preferred.

About Inceptial Tech

Inceptial Tech is a global technology solutions company operating across the UK, USA, Germany, and India, delivering IT consulting, software development, Testing-as-a-Service, and managed Oracle Cloud services.

Interested professionals with relevant experience are welcome to connect with us to discuss this opportunity.

title: Sr Network Security Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with tools such as Checkpoint Harmony, Keyfactor, and Imperva WAF, and possess a solid understanding of Microsoft 365 mail routing, DNS TXT records, and external Certificate Authorities.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  
Email Security

* Collaborate with O365 messaging teams to resolve mail delivery and routing issues.
* Work closely with the Wintel/DNS teams to manage and troubleshoot DNS TXT records.

Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
  
  

* Administer and support enterprise PKI infrastructure using Keyfactor.
* Create and modify certificate workflows, templates, and custom reports in Keyfactor.
* Manage and track certificate lifecycles to prevent service disruptions.
* Support integrations for certificate automation via Keyfactor or similar tools.
* Maintain CRLs and SCEP servers.
* Resolve incidents related to PKI and certificates from all levels of the incident queue.

Web Application Firewall (WAF)
  
  

* Administer and support Imperva WAF platform.
* Onboard and offboard websites to the WAF environment.
* Troubleshoot web application issues related to WAF configurations.
* Create, update, and tune WAF policies to ensure application availability and security.
* Work closely with the Wintel/DNS teams to manage and troubleshoot DNS TXT records and CNAMES

**Required**
Skills and Qualifications
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in Network Security operations,
* Proven expertise with Enterprise Email Security, PKI and WAF platforms

* Experience working in mid to large enterprise environments.
* Ability to work in a 24/7 operational environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems.
* Ability to write and maintain clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Experience supporting compliance and audit initiatives (e.g., SOX, NIST CSF, PCI).
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and vendors.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or related discipline
* Certifications such as Checkpoint Harmony Endpoint Specialist R81.20 (CCES), Microsoft 365 Certified Messaging Administrator Associate, Proofpoint Threat Protection Administrator
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes and workflow automation.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. title: Information Security Architect - CSIRT
description:
**Description**
**Role Summary**
This is a core investigative role on the team responsible for handling customer cybersecurity incidents — offering a unique opportunity to fight threat actors at scale. The job is investigation: driving incidents from raw log data to a defensible account of what actually happened, what the threat actor touched, and what was at risk. We want a strong, independent analyst — someone who runs to the data, builds a solid timeline from imperfect evidence, and doesn't need a senior sitting next to them to get to the answer on a well-understood incident. We are looking for people who raise the bar — if you see a broken process, you fix it; if you encounter a repetitive task, you automate it. The right person is comfortable veering from the documented playbook when an incident's attributes don't fit it — and disciplined enough to document why. Operational coordination and customer work sit on top of that investigative foundation. If you want to be right in the middle of the action fighting threat actors at scale, this is where you want to be. If you can own an investigation end-to-end and know when a case is genuinely novel enough to pull in help, this role is built for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the analysis on investigations independently — take multi-source datasets (Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), SQL) and reconstruct what the threat actor did, what they accessed, and what was at risk, across varying Salesforce products.
* Adapt the investigative approach when standard playbook procedures don't map cleanly to the incident — document the deviation and the rationale rather than working around it silently.
* Perform log analysis independently: multi-source joins, regex parsing, and hypothesis-driven pivoting across data sources — needing no assistance beyond peer review.
* Scope advanced exfiltration patterns (Aura, GraphQL, Bulk API) on well-documented TTP types without requiring senior guidance.
* Produce accurate, complete case documentation and investigation timelines; review your own case work end-to-end before submission, catching gaps proactively rather than relying on peer review — and contribute to customer-facing reports.
* Lead investigations into ATO, credential compromise, data exfiltration, and API abuse incidents; escalate genuinely novel or multi-cloud/complex cases to a Technical Lead.
* Execute containment actions independently (credential rotation, IP blocks, OAuth revocation); escalate strategic or platform-level actions (deployment moratoriums, platform cuts) for approval and appropriate stakeholder coordination.
* Interact directly with customers through our case management system and lead standard, non-hostile customer calls — explaining log data and delivering complex technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences without requiring a senior team member on the call.
* Prepare comms requests with enough technical detail that the comms team can act on them without follow-up clarification.
* Proactively identify detection opportunities and gaps surfaced during analysis — partnering with Detection Engineering to tune existing coverage and raise net-new detection logic.
* Identify procedural gaps or friction during investigations — actively documenting updates to fix broken processes and automating repetitive workflows.
* Complete AppExchange audits and ISV investigations without senior supervision on standard cases.
* Share knowledge with the team on a regular cadence — case walkthroughs, team presentations, or documentation contributions.
* Support our AI-first initiatives — use and help improve automated agents for triage, documentation, and investigation workflows.
* Build working relationships across ITM/SSRC — Detection, Product Security, Legal — and leverage them to accelerate incident resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in security incident response with consistent hands-on technical case work; currently performing active investigations, not purely coordinating.
* Strong, independent analytical skill under pressure. Demonstrated ability to take multi-source data and produce a correct, defensible account of incidents without hand-holding.
* Proficient log analysis — Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), and SQL, including multi-source joins and regex parsing — performed independently, with no more than peer review.
* Hands-on threat hunting — able to run hypothesis-driven hunts across large security datasets (NG-SIEM, Splunk) to surface malicious activity that isn't yet alerting, and pivot what you find into an active investigation.
* Solid hands-on experience with Account Takeover, credential compromise, data exfiltration, and API abuse incidents.
* Proactive "raise the bar" mindset — a track record of fixing inefficient processes, automating manual toil, and looking for ways to leave workflows better than you found them.
* Strong technical knowledge across systems, networks, cloud security, and forensic techniques.
* Demonstrated composure and judgment across multiple concurrent investigations.
* Strong familiarity with Salesforce products/ecosystems, or comparable multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Ability to lead standard customer calls and communicate complex technical findings to non-technical audiences clearly.
* Working familiarity with regional and global compliance standards (GDPR, PCI-DSS, DORA).
* Ability to drive an investigation to a clear, defensible outcome and coordinate across functions.
* Desired Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
* Software development and/or detection engineering background — comfortable writing code/scripts to extend tooling, automate repetitive investigative tasks, build agentic workflows, or translate findings into detection logic. Day-to-day this role tunes rather than owns detections (see leveling note), so this is a force-multiplier, not a core requirement.
* Prior experience operating within a large, global enterprise organization or high-scale SOC/IR environment.
* Salesforce Admin certified.
* Experience with forensic cases involving large or unusual datasets.
* Hands-on experience with AI/automation tooling in security operations (automated triage, detection tuning, agentic workflows).
* Certifications such as SANS GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, OSCP, or equivalent (or actively working toward one).
* Experience with cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud and Commerce Cloud log analysis and incident patterns.

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III to join our CloudOps team, supporting managed cloud infrastructure for our enterprise customers on AWS. This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.

  
  

You'll combine hands-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.

**Job Responsibilities:**

  
* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments
  
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
  
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high-severity issues, producing clear write-ups and remediation actions.
  
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
  
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
  
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
  
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
  
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt
  
  

**Communication & stakeholder management:**

  
* Communicate clearly and confidently with customers, Professional Services, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
  
* Plan, schedule, and run operational and governance meetings — setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and tracking follow-up actions to completion.
  
* Provide regular, well-structured status updates and reporting back to the wider CloudOps team, keeping colleagues informed of progress, risks, and changes.
  
* Represent CloudOps professionally in customer-facing forums, translating technical detail into clear, actionable communication for a range of audiences.
  
  

**Requirements :**

  
* Significant experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally within AWS environments
  
* Strong working knowledge of core AWS services (e.g. EC2, RDS) and cloud infrastructure operations
  
* Experience with monitoring/observability tooling, incident management, and change management processes.
  
* Understanding of security patching and compliance/audit processes (e.g. SOC 2).
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead meetings and communicate outcomes back to the team and to customers.
  
* Strong organisational skills and the proven ability to manage competing priorities under your own initiative.
  
* A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable working independently and knowing when to seek support from the team.
  
* Relevant AWS certification(s) desirable.
  
  

**Behavioral Competencies:**
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Drives Results
  
* Business Insight

  

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
